plan_item: 77.44.7.B — cross-block Rich Text link insertion/removal lifecycle
finding: Rich Text formatting already captured canonical per-block segments across a selection, but Inspector link controls and the link model mutation accepted only a single-block range. A selected phrase spanning paragraphs could be formatted but could not be linked through the Inspector.
change: The Inspector preserves the existing same-block/caret-in-link selection behavior and falls back to the canonical segmented selection when the selection crosses blocks.

Link insertion, URL update, mixed-target preservation and unlink apply independently to each selected block segment; block/list/table structure, inline marks, styles and out-of-selection links are preserved.
The link URL input explicitly snapshots the selection before focus moves to the control. The cache-bust token was advanced for the Editor entry point and its transitive modules.

The browser regression selects text across two paragraphs, applies marks and a link, removes and reapplies the link, verifies draft Save does not publish, then separately publishes and checks both public anchors at mobile and desktop Editor widths.
